suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require established Crohn's disease/ulcerative colitis with subsequent colorectal neoplasia/cancer; account for disease duration, extent, inflammation, dysplasia, PSC, family history, and surveillance. Established population-level risk relationship; does not prove an individual tumor was caused by IBD. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Crohn's Disease, Ulcerative Colitis) and Colon / Rectal Cancer
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
